goal: Run and job tables for AI Research Factory.
summary: Implemented core persistence models and purely additive Alembic migration for the 12-phase x 10-concurrent subagent AI Research Factory. Created tables and relationships for ResearchRun, ResearchPhase, ResearchJob (ResearchAgentJob), ResearchAttempt, ResearchLease, ResearchBudget, ResearchEvidenceResult, ProviderSemaphoreLease, and ProviderConcurrencyConfig. Enforced 10-slot uniqueness per phase wave, distributed leasing with heartbeats and fence tokens, budget tracking, and immutable SHA-256 evidence digests. Verified persistence resilience across process/session restarts.

entities_and_tables.purpose: Top-level orchestrator run across historical urn/relief subject scopes, tracking configuration version, manifest SHA-256 digest, status, and budget.
Execution trace for pipeline phases P00 through P11 with barrier gates, input/output SHA digests, wave numbering, and human sign-off triggers.
10-subagent concurrency slots per wave with unique (phase_id, slot_number), check constraint slot_number 1..10, idempotency keys, and leasing state.
Immutable execution attempts per agent job with duration, worker ID, tokens, cost, and error envelopes.
Distributed concurrency leases with worker ID, lease token, fence token, heartbeat timestamps, and TTL expiration.
Run and phase level cost, query count, and token spend caps preventing runaway provider billing.
Immutable evidence envelopes produced by subagent jobs with artifact URIs, cryptographic SHA-256 digests, and citation linkages.
Distributed cross-pod rate/concurrency semaphore for third-party inference providers.

invariants_verified.10_slot_uniqueness: uq_research_job_phase_slot strictly blocks more than 1 agent occupying the same slot within a phase wave; chk_research_job_slot_range enforces 1 <= slot <= 10.
invariants_verified.distributed_leasing: ResearchLease manages worker lock acquisition with heartbeat TTL, preventing multi-pod race conditions.
invariants_verified.negative_abuse_restart_persistence: Restarting/crashing the process or worker engine preserves complete run, phase, and job history without loss or reset.
invariants_verified.immutable_evidence_hashing: Evidence results store SHA-256 cryptographic digests of raw artifact envelopes, guaranteeing tamper detection.
invariants_verified.cascade_deletion_safety: Deleting a run cleanly cascades to all child phases, jobs, attempts, leases, budgets, and evidence records.
invariants_verified.budget_accounting: Budget rows track token consumption and cost allocations, flagging exhaustion when limits are exceeded.
